definitions.gloss: currently serialized; currently being published in installments
definitions.explanation: Indicates that a manga, novel, or other written work is actively being published in regular installments, as opposed to completed or on hiatus.

examples.japanese: この{漫画|まんが}は{連載中|れんさいちゅう}だ。
{連載中|れんさいちゅう}の{小説|しょうせつ}を{毎週|まいしゅう}{楽|たの}しみにしている。
examples.english: I look forward to the serialized novel every week.

examples.japanese: {人気|にんき}{作家|さっか}が{雑誌|ざっし}で{新|あたら}しい{作品|さくひん}を{連載中|れんさいちゅう}だ。
examples.english: A popular author is currently serializing a new work in a magazine.

notes:
A compound of {連載|れんさい} (serialization) and {中|ちゅう} (during, in the middle of). Used to indicate that a manga, novel, or other written work is currently being published in regular installments. Very common in the publishing and manga/anime world.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {連載中|れんさいちゅう}の{漫画|まんが}: currently serialized manga
- {連載中|れんさいちゅう}の{作品|さくひん}: ongoing serialized work
- {現在|げんざい}{連載中|れんさいちゅう}: currently being serialized
- {週刊誌|しゅうかんし}で{連載中|れんさいちゅう}: currently serialized in a weekly magazine

RELATED WORDS:
- {連載|れんさい}: serialization — the base noun
- {連載終了|れんさいしゅうりょう}: end of serialization — when a serial concludes
- {連載開始|れんさいかいし}: start of serialization — when a serial begins
- {休載|きゅうさい}: serialization hiatus — a temporary break in publication
